requirement.evidence: Landlords who rent any residential dwelling unit (defined as any primary residence excluding medical/long-term care or detention facilities) in the City of Hoboken are prohibited from price fixing using algorithmic pricing.
requirement.note: Prohibition, the 365-day nonpublic information definition, and enforcement by the Division of Housing or an aggrieved private citizen in Municipal Court are all in the text. The card's wording is plainer.

2. By a fine not exceeding $2,000.00; or,

3. By a period of community service not exceeding ninety (90) days.
key_value.note: The fine and community service are stated. The card omits the third option, penalties under N.J.S.A. 40:49-5, and that the penalties are alternatives available upon conviction.

effective_date.evidence: This Ordinance shall take effect immediately upon passage and publication as provided by law.
effective_date.note: The document gives adoption on Jul 9, 2025 and an effective date of immediately upon passage and publication. It does not state the 20-day rule under N.J.S.A. 40:69A-181(b) or the date 2025-07-29. Publication date is not given. The card's date depends on outside law that contradicts the ordinance's own 'immediately' wording.

status.note: The ordinance was adopted Jul 9, 2025, with no repeal or amendment shown. It is presented as current law.

coverage.note: The card's coverage is empty. The document lists no unit thresholds or construction cutoffs.

citation.evidence: ORDINANCE AMENDING AND SUPPLEMENTING CHAPTER 158 (RENT INCREASES) OF THE HOBOKEN CITY CODE BY ADDING A NEW SECTION 158-2, ENTITLED “PROHIBITION AGAINST ALGORITHMIC RENT-FIXING IN THE RENTAL HOUSING MARKET”
citation.note: The title says Section 158-2, but the body heading reads § 154-8. The document is internally inconsistent, and the codified number is not confirmed.
